run_densepose_evaluation: run DensePoseCocoEval with cocoGt and cocoDt to evaluate dense pose detection results on COCO dataset
compute_ogps_scores: compute OGPS scores between detections and ground truth using computeOgps method on DensePoseCocoEval
compute_dp_iou: compute DensePose mask IoU between detections and ground truth using computeDPIoU method
configure_eval_params: configure DensePose evaluation parameters using Params class to set IoU thresholds and area ranges
summarize_densepose_results: summarize accumulated DensePose evaluation results using summarize method to display AP and AR metrics
